title: Objaśnienia podatkowe w zakresie grup VAT
content:
Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - objaśnienia i przepisy podatkowe
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/media/gqxhys5u/obja%C5%9Bnienia_podatkowe_w_zakresie_grup_vat.pdf
- The document “Objaśnienia podatkowe w zakresie grup VAT” (issued Oct 11, 2022) explains how the VAT Group (GV) operates under Polish and EU law.
- It clarifies which tax regulations the guidance covers and aims to practicalize the VAT law for joint VAT settlements by multiple entities within a VAT group.
- Key concept: transactions between members of a VAT group are not subject to VAT.
- Contents outline:
- Idea of VAT Groups in EU law
- Who can use GV
- Formation and entry criteria for GV, including:
- Financial, economic, and organizational ties
- Tie tests and contractual arrangements
- Legal framework notes: the guidance is issued under tax law (Ordynacja podatkowa) to provide general tax explanations, with tax payer protection under specific articles if followed in a given period.
